formation.explanation: Client proposals allocate an origin-row instance and preaccept with dependency/sequence attributes from conflict indexes. Acceptor preaccept reports are filtered by the coordinator attempt and phase; replies merge attributes. The configured fast threshold with equality/commit-prefix/initial-ballot conditions commits; otherwise an Accept phase uses acceptOKs+1>N/2. Commit broadcasts full commands and dependencies; receivers install only when not already committed and not below their promise. Execution waits for dependency availability/commitment, traverses SCCs, executes and responds through retained client proposals. Actual formulas and absent status changes are observations requiring validation, not assertions of quorum sufficiency.

context.explanation: Authority is scoped to origin-row/instance and ballot, not one global log leader. startRecovery replaces bookkeeping, retains proposals, chooses an attempt ballot, retags its local entry and includes a self report before Prepare broadcast. Remote Prepare raises only the promise bal and reports vbal separately. Coordinator accepts matching-attempt replies while preparing, waits for SlowQuorumSize including self, selects by VBallot, then installs committed data, resumes Accept, or restarts phase1. Old requests below a local promise are dropped/reported without replacement; old reply ballots and finished phases are filtered. Same-ballot reuse remains open. The PrepareReply codec omits VBallot, so fresh decoded reports lose nonzero value tags; wider recovery effects remain open.

connection.explanation: Recovery reports are the bridge from prior formation to authority transfer: promise Ballot qualifies the new attempt, while VBallot and Status decide which existing support the new coordinator uses. Commit/execute states constrain overwrite and skip ordinary recovery. Pending proposals survive bookkeeping replacement and may be requeued on own-row NOOP commit. The execution watcher can solicit recovery for missing/uncommitted known work; master selection only influences makeBallot through IsLeader. Wire decoding lies directly on the report path: the current PrepareReply codec does not preserve the producer VBallot. No unread persistent recovery mechanism is assumed to repair it.

grounding.derivation: A matching AcceptReply is counted by handleAcceptReply as successful accept support toward commitment. The receiver stores the proposed attributes on its eligible branch. handlePrepare exports Instance.Status as the phase of that retained support, and handlePrepareReply deliberately treats ACCEPTED as a stronger recovery case than PREACCEPTED. The PreAccept guard and findPreAcceptConflicts comment also protect ACCEPTED-or-later instances from regression. Composing these duties requires an eligible acceptor to represent its retained support as ACCEPTED or later until superseded by another legal value transition. The duty is phase fidelity of accepted support, not an assertion that a particular quorum formula is safe.
